annotations.note: British Commandos and the new U.S. Army Rangers were celebrated in the 1942 press, and the idea of amphibious 'commando' work had a romantic appeal.
Southern Maryland was known for its (legal in some counties) slot machines from the 1940s to the 1960s.
A racial slur for the Black pianist. It was common in white speech of the period and is kept as written as part of the historical record.
